verses.ar: «عَهْدًا قَطَعْتُ لِعَيْنَيَّ، فَكَيْفَ أَتَطَلَّعُ فِي عَذْرَاءَ؟
verses.kjv: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
verses.web: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

verses.ar: وَمَا هِيَ قِسْمَةُ ٱللهِ مِنْ فَوْقُ، وَنَصِيبُ ٱلْقَدِيرِ مِنَ ٱلْأَعَالِي؟
verses.kjv: For what portion of God [is there] from above? and [what] inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
verses.web: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?

verses.ar: أَلَيْسَ ٱلْبَوَارُ لِعَامِلِ ٱلشَّرِّ، وَٱلنُّكْرُ لِفَاعِلِي ٱلْإِثْمِ؟
verses.kjv: [Is] not destruction to the wicked? and a strange [punishment] to the workers of iniquity?
verses.web: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

verses.ar: أَلَيْسَ هُوَ يَنْظُرُ طُرُقِي، وَيُحْصِي جَمِيعَ خَطَوَاتِي؟
verses.kjv: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
verses.web: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?

verses.ar: إِنْ كُنْتُ قَدْ سَلَكْتُ مَعَ ٱلْكَذِبِ، أَوْ أَسْرَعَتْ رِجْلِي إِلَى ٱلْغِشِّ،
verses.kjv: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
verses.web: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit

verses.ar: لِيَزِنِّي فِي مِيزَانِ ٱلْحَقِّ، فَيَعْرِفَ ٱللهُ كَمَالِي.
verses.kjv: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity.
verses.web: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

verses.ar: إِنْ حَادَتْ خَطَوَاتِي عَنِ ٱلطَّرِيقِ، وَذَهَبَ قَلْبِي وَرَاءَ عَيْنَيَّ، أَوْ لَصِقَ عَيْبٌ بِكَفِّي،
verses.kjv: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;
verses.web: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,

verses.ar: أَزْرَعْ وَغَيْرِي يَأْكُلْ، وَفُرُوعِي تُسْتَأْصَلْ.
verses.kjv: [Then] let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
verses.web: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

verses.ar: «إِنْ غَوِيَ قَلْبِي عَلَى ٱمْرَأَةٍ، أَوْ كَمَنْتُ عَلَى بَابِ قَرِيبِي،
verses.kjv: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or [if] I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door;
verses.web: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,

verses.ar: فَلْتَطْحَنِ ٱمْرَأَتِي لِآخَرَ، وَلْيَنْحَنِ عَلَيْهَا آخَرُونَ.
verses.kjv: [Then] let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
verses.web: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ هَذِهِ رَذِيلَةٌ، وَهِيَ إِثْمٌ يُعْرَضُ لِلْقُضَاةِ.
verses.kjv: For this [is] an heinous crime; yea, it [is] an iniquity [to be punished by] the judges.
verses.web: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهَا نَارٌ تَأْكُلُ حَتَّى إِلَى ٱلْهَلَاكِ، وَتَسْتَأْصِلُ كُلَّ مَحْصُولِي.
verses.kjv: For it [is] a fire [that] consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.
verses.web: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

verses.ar: «إِنْ كُنْتُ رَفَضْتُ حَقَّ عَبْدِي وَأَمَتِي فِي دَعْوَاهُمَا عَلَيَّ،
verses.kjv: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
verses.web: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,

verses.ar: فَمَاذَا كُنْتُ أَصْنَعُ حِينَ يَقُومُ ٱللهُ؟ وَإِذَا ٱفْتَقَدَ، فَبِمَاذَا أُجِيبُهُ؟
verses.kjv: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
verses.web: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?

verses.ar: أَوَلَيْسَ صَانِعِي فِي ٱلْبَطْنِ صَانِعَهُ، وَقَدْ صَوَّرَنَا وَاحِدٌ فِي ٱلرَّحِمِ؟
verses.kjv: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
verses.web: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

verses.ar: إِنْ كُنْتُ مَنَعْتُ ٱلْمَسَاكِينَ عَنْ مُرَادِهِمْ، أَوْ أَفْنَيْتُ عَيْنَيِ ٱلْأَرْمَلَةِ،
verses.kjv: If I have withheld the poor from [their] desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
verses.web: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

verses.ar: أَوْ أَكَلْتُ لُقْمَتِي وَحْدِي فَمَا أَكَلَ مِنْهَا ٱلْيَتِيمُ.
verses.kjv: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
verses.web: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it

verses.ar: بَلْ مُنْذُ صِبَايَ كَبِرَ عِنْدِي كَأَبٍ، وَمِنْ بَطْنِ أُمِّي هَدَيْتُهَا.
verses.kjv: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as [with] a father, and I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)
verses.web: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);

verses.ar: إِنْ كُنْتُ رَأَيْتُ هَالِكًا لِعَدَمِ ٱللِّبْسِ أَوْ فَقِيرًا بِلَا كِسْوَةٍ،
verses.kjv: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
verses.web: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

verses.ar: إِنْ لَمْ تُبَارِكْنِي حَقَوَاهُ وَقَدِ ٱسْتَدْفَأَ بِجَزَّةِ غَنَمِي.
verses.kjv: If his loins have not blessed me, and [if] he were [not] warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
verses.web: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;

verses.ar: إِنْ كُنْتُ قَدْ هَزَزْتُ يَدِي عَلَى ٱلْيَتِيمِ لَمَّا رَأَيْتُ عَوْنِي فِي ٱلْبَابِ،
verses.kjv: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
verses.web: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;

verses.ar: فَلْتَسْقُطْ عَضُدِي مِنْ كَتِفِي، وَلْتَنْكَسِرْ ذِرَاعِي مِنْ قَصَبَتِهَا،
verses.kjv: [Then] let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.
verses.web: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْبَوَارَ مِنَ ٱللهِ رُعْبٌ عَلَيَّ، وَمِنْ جَلَالِهِ لَمْ أَسْتَطِعْ.
verses.kjv: For destruction [from] God [was] a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
verses.web: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.

verses.ar: «إِنْ كُنْتُ قَدْ جَعَلْتُ ٱلذَّهَبَ عَمْدَتِي، أَوْ قُلْتُ لِلْإِبْرِيزِ: أَنْتَ مُتَّكَلِي.
verses.kjv: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, [Thou art] my confidence;
verses.web: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’

verses.ar: إِنْ كُنْتُ قَدْ فَرِحْتُ إِذْ كَثُرَتْ ثَرْوَتِي وَلِأَنَّ يَدِي وَجَدَتْ كَثِيرًا.
verses.kjv: If I rejoiced because my wealth [was] great, and because mine hand had gotten much;
verses.web: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

verses.ar: إِنْ كُنْتُ قَدْ نَظَرْتُ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ حِينَ ضَاءَ، أَوْ إِلَى ٱلْقَمَرِ يَسِيرُ بِٱلْبَهَاءِ،
verses.kjv: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking [in] brightness;
verses.web: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

verses.ar: وَغَوِيَ قَلْبِي سِرًّا، وَلَثَمَ يَدِي فَمِي،
verses.kjv: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:
verses.web: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;

verses.ar: فَهَذَا أَيْضًا إِثْمٌ يُعْرَضُ لِلْقُضَاةِ، لِأَنِّي أَكُونُ قَدْ جَحَدْتُ ٱللهَ مِنْ فَوْقُ.
verses.kjv: This also [were] an iniquity [to be punished by] the judge: for I should have denied the God [that is] above.
verses.web: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.

verses.ar: «إِنْ كُنْتُ قَدْ فَرِحْتُ بِبَلِيَّةِ مُبْغِضِي أَوْ شَمِتُّ حِينَ أَصَابَهُ سُوءٌ.
verses.kjv: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
verses.web: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him

verses.ar: بَلْ لَمْ أَدَعْ حَنَكِي يُخْطِئُ فِي طَلَبِ نَفْسِهِ بِلَعْنَةٍ.
verses.kjv: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
verses.web: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

verses.ar: إِنْ كَانَ أَهْلُ خَيْمَتِي لَمْ يَقُولُوا: مَنْ يَأْتِي بِأَحَدٍ لَمْ يَشْبَعْ مِنْ طَعَامِهِ؟
verses.kjv: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
verses.web: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’

verses.ar: غَرِيبٌ لَمْ يَبِتْ فِي ٱلْخَارِجِ. فَتَحْتُ لِلْمُسَافِرِ أَبْوَابِي.
verses.kjv: The stranger did not lodge in the street: [but] I opened my doors to the traveller.
verses.web: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);

verses.ar: إِنْ كُنْتُ قَدْ كَتَمْتُ كَٱلنَّاسِ ذَنْبِي لِإِخْفَاءِ إِثْمِي فِي حِضْنِي.
verses.kjv: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:
verses.web: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

verses.ar: إِذْ رَهِبْتُ جُمْهُورًا غَفِيرًا، وَرَوَّعَتْنِي إِهَانَةُ ٱلْعَشَائِرِ، فَكَفَفْتُ وَلَمْ أَخْرُجْ مِنَ ٱلْبَابِ.
verses.kjv: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, [and] went not out of the door?
verses.web: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—

verses.ar: مَنْ لِي بِمَنْ يَسْمَعُنِي؟ هُوَذَا إِمْضَائِي. لِيُجِبْنِي ٱلْقَدِيرُ. وَمَنْ لِي بِشَكْوَى كَتَبَهَا خَصْمِي،
verses.kjv: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire [is, that] the Almighty would answer me, and [that] mine adversary had written a book.
verses.web: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!

verses.ar: فَكُنْتُ أَحْمِلُهَا عَلَى كَتِفِي. كُنْتُ أُعْصِبُهَا تَاجًا لِي.
verses.kjv: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, [and] bind it [as] a crown to me.
verses.web: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.

verses.ar: كُنْتُ أُخْبِرُهُ بِعَدَدِ خَطَوَاتِي وَأَدْنُو مِنْهُ كَشَرِيفٍ.
verses.kjv: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
verses.web: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.

verses.ar: إِنْ كَانَتْ أَرْضِي قَدْ صَرَخَتْ عَلَيَّ وَتَبَاكَتْ أَتْلَامُهَا جَمِيعًا.
verses.kjv: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
verses.web: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

verses.ar: إِنْ كُنْتُ قَدْ أَكَلْتُ غَلَّتَهَا بِلَا فِضَّةٍ، أَوْ أَطْفَأْتُ أَنْفُسَ أَصْحَابِهَا،
verses.kjv: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
verses.web: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

verses.ar: فَعِوَضَ ٱلْحِنْطَةِ لِيَنْبُتْ شَوْكٌ، وَبَدَلَ ٱلشَّعِيرِ زَوَانٌ». تَمَّتْ أَقْوَالُ أَيُّوبَ.
verses.kjv: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
verses.web: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.
